entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
We have indeed sent down it (i.e. the Qur'aan) on the Night of Decree.
And what have you come to know what the Night of Decree is?
(Worshipping in) the Night of Decree is better than (worshipping for) a thousand months.
Therein descend the angels and Jibra'eel, by the command of their Lord, for all tasks.
That (night) is (full of) peace until the rising of the dawn.
